PROBLEMSENCOUNTERED:

2017-12-03 1250 m MD /Namsang 1 cementing_issue /low | 2.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Namsang.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2017-12-04 /1269 m MD /Girujan/wellbore instability /medium / 3.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Girujan, oversized cuttings at surface.
Remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.

2017-12-05 / 2038 m MD1Barail/cementing_issue/low /2.7 hrs NPT
Cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Barail.
Remedy: staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.

2017-12-08 / 3123 m MD /Sylhet I overpressure / critical28.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Sylhet, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
Remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.
